layers.process: El Cocuy National Natural Park (Sierra Nevada del Cocuy): no visitor may enter without a guide or interpreter of natural and cultural heritage. The regulation annex sets five visitors per guide for ascents (an older page said four). An induction talk is also required.
The park page asks for booking at least 90 days ahead. Guiding, transport, lodging and food are not included in the entry ticket, which covers the three authorised trails for 4 days.
